title: Carrier Migration, the Forty-Eight Projection Matrix and Observation Thresholds
summary: Hybrid civilizational carriers show that functions can be redistributed among states, cities, firms, platforms, networks and other organizations. The Forty-Eight Runtime Projection Matrix unfolds current structures into multiple conditional paths, while possibility space and observation thresholds define when a possibility has accumulated enough observable signals to merit attention.

blocks.text: Hybrid civilizational carriers show that functions can be redistributed among states, cities, firms, platforms, networks and other organizations. The Forty-Eight Runtime Projection Matrix unfolds current structures into multiple conditional paths, while possibility space and observation thresholds define when a possibility has accumulated enough observable signals to merit attention.

Projection is not prediction, and a possibility space is not a list of outcomes. The matrix only asks which paths are worth observing if specified conditions continue. Where evidence is insufficient, UNKNOWN must remain explicit, and reality may move beyond the listed paths.

Projection ≠ Prediction. The Forty-Eight Runtime Projection Matrix unfolds conditional paths only. When observation is insufficient or thresholds have not been crossed, UNKNOWN remains explicit and possibility space is not rewritten as a certain outcome.
